en_summary: $CRWD has agreed to acquire $ZS in an all-stock deal for $43.9 billion, surpassing Google's $32B acquisition of Wiz as the largest cybersecurity acquisition. Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per share, valuing ZS at approximately $260, a 34% premium to Friday's close. Combined company will have more than $10B in ARR. The bears are having their moment.

After predicting a top in the AI trade every month for the last 4 years, the bears finally got their moment last week.

However, in 3 to 6 months, we are going to look back at this correction and realize it was just that: a correction.

There is a widespread narrative right now that Nvidia, $NVDA, is quite literally going to collapse. This is a stock that was trading at a record high on October 6th, worth nearly $6 trillion, and the inventor of the most advanced chips in the world (it's not even close).

That's how deeply pessimistic sentiment has become over the last seven weeks.

Even if Nvidia produced half as much revenue as they are guiding for their next fiscal year, this company would still produce close to $400 billion in annual revenue.

Meanwhile, the S&P 500 has posted three consecutive quarters with earnings growth above 25% and eight straight quarters of double-digit growth.

And, sentiment flipped so quickly that the S&P 500 closed the week 4.1 standard deviations below its 50-day moving average on Friday. Not even 2020 and 2008 saw such an occurrence.

The reality is that AI truly is the "next big thing" and the AI buildout is only accelerating.

Bears will sound smart, bulls will make money.

Is there a fix for $BTC's quantum risk?

Ran Neuner sees a quantum threat in the foreseeable future and doesn't think anyone will save Bitcoin, because its devs can't agree on a solution

"I hate saying it because I think Bitcoin did start this industry, but it doesn't excite me anymore."

"I do hold a lot of Bitcoin and I hold them as an insurance policy and because I'm emotionally attached to them. I don't say I don't like the Bitcoin thesis, because I do."

"Technology is moving very fast. At some point there's going to be a technological risk to Bitcoin."

"When that technological risk happens, I don't believe that there's going to be anyone to save us. Quantum computing is the risk in the foreseeable future."

"I've seen these Bitcoin devs. I've seen them trying to coordinate. It's worse than when my kids order pizza."

"They can't decide what pizza they want. This one wants olives, this one wants cheese. That's how the Bitcoin devs are when it comes to quantum."

Is there still a thesis for holding $ETH and $SOL?

Ran Neuner says he isn't bullish on L1s yet and prefers protocols like Hyperliquid and Backpack, with real, growing revenue that flows back to token holders

"I don't like the layer 1 thesis at all. In order for a token to have value, it's either going to be really scarce, or it's going to have a way of paying dividends or money to its holders."

"If you think about ETH or SOL, they're not really scarce assets, because they just keep minting more. They don't have a buyback program, or they don't give any money back to the holder."

"I'm not really bullish layer 1s yet, but I am bullish things on top of the layer 1s, where they do have the correct economics."

"I'm bullish on things like Hyperliquid. I'm bullish on a protocol called Backpack."

"It's got to have a real use case. It's got to have real and growing users, with real and growing revenue. And then it's got to have a way of giving value back to the token holders."

zh_summary: 這是一個很好的視覺呈現，顯示 AI 數據中心建設已進行多少與仍面臨政治障礙的程度。$AMZN 在美國擁有最大 AI 數據中心管道，但 AWS 已宣布但尚未開始建設的約 80% 位於被分類為限制或敵對的州，可能造成許可延遲、更高電力成本與項目搬遷。同時 $META 和 $GOOGL 已有 15 GW 和 13 GW 在建設中，而目前活躍僅 6 GW 和 7 GW，使他們在下一波擴張中更進一步。$ORCL 面臨相反挑戰，6 GW 在建設中對比僅 1 GW 活躍，但幾乎沒有更多宣布。人人都在比較這些公司計劃的 AI 容量，但 2027 年的真正優勢將是誰能實際建成並連接到電網。
en_summary: This is a great visual of how much of the AI data center buildout is already underway versus how much still faces political hurdles. $AMZN has largest AI data center pipeline in America but ~80% of what AWS has announced and not yet started building sits in states classified as restrictive or hostile creating potential permitting delays, higher power costs and project relocations. Meanwhile $META and $GOOGL already have 15 GW and 13 GW under construction against just 6 GW and 7 GW currently active putting them further along in their next wave of expansion. $ORCL has opposite challenge with 6 GW under construction against just 1 GW active but almost nothing announced beyond that. Everyone keeps comparing how much AI capacity these companies have planned but real advantage in 2027 will be who can actually get it built and connected to the grid.
